description.text: A high-class pack released on 1 December 2023 with shiny Pokémon, the rare Pokémon whose colors differ from the usual, beside reprints of Pokémon that did well in battle, some in new illustrations, such as Koraidon ex, Miraidon ex, Ting-Lu ex, Chien-Pao ex and Mew ex. Each pack held ten cards, one of them a Pokémon ex, and Clive appears as a Supporter for the first time. The cards are numbered to 190, followed by shiny Pokémon marked S, shiny Pokémon ex marked SSR, Art Rare Pokémon, full-art Super Rare Supporters, Special Art Rare cards such as Mew ex, Charizard ex and Iono, and Ultra Rare Koraidon ex, Miraidon ex and the four Treasures of Ruin, drawn in gold lines. In English many of its cards came out in Paldean Fates in January 2024.

description.text: This Special Art Rare by USGMEN, showing a Shiny Mew, is one of two new Shiny Mew ex in Shiny Treasure ex, beside a shiny full art by aky CG Works; English Paldean Fates has both. In Simplified Chinese the same art came only in packs of 惊 (Surprise), the third wave of Collect 151, on sale from 18 July 2025.
